Take 5, 10, 15 and 20ml of 0.1 M potassium iodide solution in four conical flasks A, B, C and D respectively.
Measure 10 ml 2.5M H[sub]2[/sub]SO[sub]4[/sub] in a measuring jar.

Plot a graph between time taken for the appearance of blue colour and 1/Vol. of KI by taking time (t) along ordinate and 1/Vol. of KI along abscissa. It should be a straight sloping line.
